source.text: Παρακαλῶ οὖν ὑμᾶς ἐγὼ ὁ δέσμιος ἐν κυρίῳ ἀξίως περιπατῆσαι τῆς κλήσεως ἧς ἐκλήθητε, μετὰ πάσης ταπεινοφροσύνης καὶ πραΰτητος, μετὰ μακροθυμίας, ἀνεχόμενοι ἀλλήλων ἐν ἀγάπῃ, σπουδάζοντες τηρεῖν τὴν ἑνότητα τοῦ πνεύματος ἐν τῷ συνδέσμῳ τῆς εἰρήνης·

records.literal_gloss: I urge therefore you, I the prisoner in [the] Lord, worthily to walk of the calling with which you were called, \v 2 with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love, \v 3 being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of the peace;

en.L: I therefore, the prisoner in [the] Lord, urge you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called, \v 2 with all humility and gentleness, with patience, bearing with one another in love, \v 3 being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.
en.B: So I, a prisoner for the Lord, appeal to you: live in a way that is worthy of God's call, the call that came to you. \v 2 Be humble and gentle in every way, and be patient, putting up with one another in love. \v 3 Spare no effort to keep the unity the Spirit gives, with peace as the bond that holds you together.
en.R: I am a prisoner because I belong to the Lord. So I beg you: live the kind of life that fits what God called you to be. \v 2 Always be humble and gentle. Be patient, and put up with each other because you love each other. \v 3 The Spirit has made you one. Work hard to keep it that way, and let peace hold you together.

es.L: {{plural_you:Les|Os}} ruego, pues, yo, el prisionero en [el] Señor, que {{plural_you:anden|andéis}} de manera digna del llamamiento con que {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} llamados, \v 2 con toda humildad y mansedumbre, con paciencia, {{plural_you:soportándose|soportándoos}} unos a otros en amor, \v 3 {{plural_you:esforzándose|esforzándoos}} por guardar la unidad del Espíritu en el vínculo de la paz.
es.B: Así que yo, prisionero por el Señor, {{plural_you:les|os}} ruego: {{plural_you:vivan|vivid}} de una manera digna del llamado de Dios, el llamado que {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}}. \v 2 {{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} humildes y mansos en todo, y {{plural_you:sean|sed}} pacientes, {{plural_you:soportándose|soportándoos}} unos a otros con amor. \v 3 No {{plural_you:escatimen|escatiméis}} esfuerzos por mantener la unidad que da el Espíritu, con la paz como el lazo que {{plural_you:los|os}} mantiene unidos.
es.R: Estoy preso porque pertenezco al Señor. Por eso {{plural_you:les|os}} suplico: {{plural_you:lleven|llevad}} la clase de vida que corresponde a lo que Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} llamó a ser. \v 2 {{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} siempre humildes y amables. {{plural_you:Tengan|Tened}} paciencia y {{plural_you:sopórtense|soportaos}} unos a otros, porque {{plural_you:se aman|os amáis}}. \v 3 El Espíritu {{plural_you:los|os}} ha hecho uno. {{plural_you:Esfuércense|Esforzaos}} por seguir así, y {{plural_you:dejen|dejad}} que la paz {{plural_you:los|os}} mantenga unidos.

sw.L: Basi, ninawasihi ninyi, mimi mfungwa katika Bwana, mwenende kwa namna inayostahili wito ambao mliitwa nao, \v 2 pamoja na unyenyekevu wote na upole, pamoja na saburi, mkivumiliana katika upendo, \v 3 mkifanya bidii kutunza umoja wa Roho katika kifungo cha amani.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo mimi, niliye mfungwa kwa ajili ya Bwana, ninawaomba: ishini maisha yanayostahili wito wa Mungu, wito ule mlioupokea. \v 2 Kuweni wanyenyekevu na wapole kwa kila namna, na wavumilivu, mkichukuliana kwa upendo. \v 3 Fanyeni kila juhudi kudumisha umoja ambao Roho huwapa, na amani iwe kifungo kinachowaunganisha.
sw.R: Mimi ni mfungwa kwa sababu mimi ni wa Bwana. Kwa hiyo nawaomba sana: ishini maisha yanayofaa watu ambao Mungu amewaita. \v 2 Kuweni wanyenyekevu na wapole siku zote. Kuweni wavumilivu, na mchukuliane kwa sababu mnapendana. \v 3 Roho amewafanya kuwa wamoja. Jitahidini sana kudumisha hali hiyo, na amani iwaunganishe pamoja.

decisions.choice: therefore: the life now urged follows from what God has done in chapters 1-3
decisions.reason: οὖν turns the letter from what God has done (chapters 1-3: chosen, raised with Christ, Jews and Gentiles made one body) to how those who have received it are to live (chapters 4-6).

decisions.choice: the prisoner in the Lord: in chains because he belongs to the Lord and serves him
alternatives: a prisoner of the Lord, held captive by him (in a figurative sense)
decisions.reason: Paul wrote as a prisoner (3:1; 6:20). "In the Lord" says why: his imprisonment is part of his service to Christ, not a mark against him, and it gives weight to his appeal.

decisions.choice: walk worthily of the calling: live in a way that matches God's call
decisions.reason: "Walk" is a common biblical picture for the way a person lives (2:2, 2:10; Colossians 1:10). The calling is God's call that made them his people (1:18; 4:4); their conduct is to fit it.

decisions.choice: the unity of the Spirit: the oneness the Spirit has created, which they are to keep
alternatives: a unity of human spirit or attitude
decisions.reason: They are not told to make unity but to keep it: the Spirit has already joined Jews and Gentiles into one body (2:18, 2:22). The bond that holds it is peace, the peace Christ made between them (2:14-17).

decisions.choice: worthy of God's call, the call that came to you; what God called you to be
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God as the one who calls (m3), which the Greek passive implies.

decisions.choice: The Spirit has made you one. Work hard to keep it that way
decisions.reason: Readable says first what the Spirit has done, then what they must do (m4).

decisions.choice: ustedes / vosotros forms
decisions.reason: Paul writes to the church in the plural throughout. Every plural "you" addressed to the readers, with its pronouns and verbs, is a reader setting: ustedes forms (Latin America, the default) or vosotros forms (Spain). Each span covers only the words that differ ("{{plural_you:les|os}} ruego").

decisions.choice: mwenende (L); ishini maisha (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the picture of walking with "kuenenda", the Swahili verb for walking that is also used of how a person conducts life. Balanced and Readable say "ishini maisha" (live a life), as the meaning decision has it. The same choice holds in verse 17.

source.text: ἓν σῶμα καὶ ἓν πνεῦμα, καθὼς καὶ ἐκλήθητε ἐν μιᾷ ἐλπίδι τῆς κλήσεως ὑμῶν·

records.literal_gloss: one body and one Spirit, just as also you were called in one hope of the calling of you;

en.L: [There is] one body and one Spirit, just as you also were called in one hope of your calling;
en.B: There is one body and one Spirit, just as there is one hope that belongs to the call you received.
en.R: There is only one body, the church, and there is only one Spirit. In the same way, when God called you, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave all of you one hope to share.

es.L: [Hay] un solo cuerpo y un solo Espíritu, así como también {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} llamados en una sola esperanza de {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} llamamiento;
es.B: Hay un solo cuerpo y un solo Espíritu, así como hay una sola esperanza, la que pertenece al llamado que {{plural_you:recibieron|recibisteis}}.
es.R: Hay un solo cuerpo, la iglesia, y hay un solo Espíritu. Del mismo modo, cuando Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} llamó, {{plural_you:les|os}} dio a todos una misma esperanza.

sw.L: [Kuna] mwili mmoja na Roho mmoja, kama vile pia mliitwa katika tumaini moja la wito wenu;
sw.B: Kuna mwili mmoja na Roho mmoja, kama vile kuna tumaini moja linalotokana na wito mlioupokea.
sw.R: Kuna mwili mmoja tu, yaani kanisa, na kuna Roho mmoja tu. Vivyo hivyo, Mungu alipowaita, aliwapa ninyi nyote tumaini moja, lile lile kwa wote.

decisions.choice: one body: the church; one Spirit: the Holy Spirit
decisions.reason: The body is the church, Christ's body (1:22-23; 2:16). The Spirit is the one Spirit through whom Jews and Gentiles both have access to the Father (2:18), the same Spirit as in verse 3.

decisions.choice: in one hope of your calling: the one hope that God's call brings
decisions.reason: The hope is what God called them to look forward to: the inheritance and the glory of 1:18. All share one hope, because all were called by the one God.

decisions.choice: there is: the verb is supplied
decisions.reason: Verses 4-6 are a list with no verb, perhaps drawn from words the churches already knew. The sense is a statement: there is one body, one Spirit, and so on.

decisions.choice: the church; when God called you, he gave
decisions.reason: Readable says who the body is (m1) and who called them.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span on "les dio"
decisions.reason: Where the English has "{{deity_pronoun:he|He}}" as a subject, Spanish leaves the subject inside the verb ("dio"), so there is nothing to capitalise. In this chapter the setting goes on free pronouns that refer to God or Christ: "él" after a preposition, "lo", "le" and "su".

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span on "aliwapa"
decisions.reason: Swahili marks the subject inside the verb (a-liwapa), and a prefix cannot take a capital. So Swahili has fewer spans than the English: in this chapter they go only on free pronouns and possessives ("yeye", "kwake", "wake", "yake", "zake").

source.text: εἷς κύριος, μία πίστις, ἓν βάπτισμα·

records.literal_gloss: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;

en.L: one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
en.B: There is one Lord, one faith, one baptism,
en.R: There is one Lord, and there is one faith and one baptism.

es.L: un solo Señor, una sola fe, un solo bautismo;
es.B: Hay un solo Señor, una sola fe, un solo bautismo,
es.R: Hay un solo Señor, y hay una sola fe y un solo bautismo.

sw.L: Bwana mmoja, imani moja, ubatizo mmoja;
sw.B: Kuna Bwana mmoja, imani moja, ubatizo mmoja,
sw.R: Kuna Bwana mmoja, na kuna imani moja na ubatizo mmoja.

decisions.choice: one Lord: Jesus Christ
decisions.reason: Paul calls Jesus the one Lord beside the one God the Father (1 Corinthians 8:6), and verse 6 goes on to the Father.

decisions.choice: one faith: the one trust in Christ that all believers share
decisions.reason: Here faith is the trust in the one Lord that all of them have; verse 13 speaks of growing into "the unity of the faith". It may also include what is believed, since the two cannot be separated here.

decisions.choice: one baptism: the baptism every believer received in the name of Jesus
decisions.reason: There is one baptism, into the one Lord, for Jews and Gentiles alike (Galatians 3:27-28).

source.text: εἷς θεὸς καὶ πατὴρ πάντων, ὁ ἐπὶ πάντων καὶ διὰ πάντων καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν.

records.literal_gloss: one God and Father of all, the [one] over all and through all and in all.

en.L: one God and Father of all, who [is] over all and through all and in all.
en.B: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in all.
en.R: And there is one God, the Father of all. He rules over all, works through all, and is in all.

es.L: un solo Dios y Padre de todos, el cual [está] sobre todos, y por medio de todos, y en todos.
es.B: un solo Dios y Padre de todos, que está sobre todos, y por medio de todos, y en todos.
es.R: Y hay un solo Dios, el Padre de todos. Él gobierna sobre todos, obra por medio de todos y está en todos.

sw.L: Mungu mmoja na Baba wa wote, aliye juu ya wote na kupitia wote na ndani ya wote.
sw.B: Mungu mmoja, Baba wa wote, ambaye yuko juu ya wote, na kupitia wote, na ndani ya wote.
sw.R: Na kuna Mungu mmoja, Baba wa wote. Yeye anatawala juu ya wote, anafanya kazi kupitia wote, na yumo ndani ya wote.

decisions.choice: all: everything God has made, with his people chiefly in view
decisions.reason: The Greek form can mean "all people" or "all things". God is Father of every family (3:14-15) and works all things (1:11), yet the list is about the church's unity, so believers are chiefly in view. The text keeps the open "all".

decisions.choice: over all, through all, in all: God rules everything, works through everything, and is present in everything
decisions.reason: The three phrases say that the one God is above all as ruler, active through all, and present in all. This is why there can be only one people of God.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "in all"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "us" ("in us all"), and some "you". Important early manuscripts have only "in all". The added word narrows the phrase to believers.

decisions.choice: rules over all, works through all, and is in all
decisions.reason: Readable gives each short phrase a verb to say what God does (m2).

decisions.choice: todos
decisions.reason: The Greek form can mean all people or all things (m1); Spanish has to choose. "Todos" (everyone) fits the meaning decision, which has believers chiefly in view, while "sobre todo" would also read as the idiom "above all". For review: "todos" is narrower than the open Greek.

decisions.choice: wote
decisions.reason: Swahili agreement makes the choice the Greek leaves open: "wote" (class 2) is all people, "vyote" or "yote" all things. "Wote" follows the meaning decision, which has God's people chiefly in view (m1). For review: it is narrower than the Greek.

source.text: Ἑνὶ δὲ ἑκάστῳ ἡμῶν ἐδόθη ἡ χάρις κατὰ τὸ μέτρον τῆς δωρεᾶς τοῦ Χριστοῦ.

records.literal_gloss: To one but each of us was given the grace according to the measure of the gift of the Christ.

en.L: But to each one of us grace was given according to the measure of the gift of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}.
en.B: But grace was given to each one of us, in the measure in which {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} gave it.
en.R: But {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} has given grace to each one of us. He decided how much to give each of us.

es.L: Pero a cada uno de nosotros fue dada la gracia según la medida del don {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}.
es.B: Pero a cada uno de nosotros se le dio gracia, en la medida en que {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} la repartió.
es.R: Pero {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} nos ha dado gracia a cada uno de nosotros. Él decidió cuánto dar a cada uno.

sw.L: Lakini kwa kila mmoja wetu neema ilitolewa kulingana na kipimo cha zawadi ya {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Lakini kila mmoja wetu amepewa neema, kwa kipimo ambacho {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} aliitoa.
sw.R: Lakini {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} amempa kila mmoja wetu neema. Yeye ndiye aliyeamua kila mmoja apewe kiasi gani.

decisions.choice: grace: God's free gift, here the gift that fits each believer for a part in the church's life
decisions.reason: Paul spoke of the grace given to him to make him a servant of the gospel (3:7-8). Each believer, not only apostles, has received grace in this sense, and verses 11-16 show what it is for.

decisions.choice: the measure of the gift of Christ: the amount Christ chose to give
decisions.reason: Christ is the giver (verses 8 and 11). Each one's gift is measured out by him, so no one has all of them and no one has none.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article: "the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}".

decisions.choice: He decided how much to give each of us
decisions.reason: Readable explains "according to the measure of the gift" (m2).

decisions.choice: {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}; {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}
decisions.reason: Spanish says "Cristo" without an article but "el Mesías" with one, and "de el" contracts to "del", so the span takes in the article and the preposition ("a Cristo" | "al Mesías" in verse 20). Literal does the same: "del Cristo" is not natural Spanish, so the Greek article shows only in the Messiah alternative.

source.text: διὸ λέγει· Ἀναβὰς εἰς ὕψος ᾐχμαλώτευσεν αἰχμαλωσίαν, ἔδωκεν δόματα τοῖς ἀνθρώποις.

records.literal_gloss: Therefore it says: Having gone up to height he took captive captivity, he gave gifts to the men.

en.L: Therefore it says, "Having ascended on high, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} led captivity captive; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave gifts to {{gender:people|men}}."
en.B: That is why it says, "When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went up on high, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} led a band of captives, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave gifts to {{gender:people|men}}."
en.R: That is why Scripture says, "When {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} went up to the highest place, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} took many prisoners, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave gifts to {{gender:people|men}}."

es.L: Por eso dice: «Habiendo subido a lo alto, llevó cautiva la cautividad; dio dones a {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}».
es.B: Por eso dice: «Cuando subió a lo alto, llevó consigo una fila de cautivos y dio dones a {{gender:los seres humanos|los hombres}}».
es.R: Por eso dice la Escritura: «Cuando subió al lugar más alto, tomó muchos prisioneros y dio regalos a {{gender:la gente|los hombres}}».

sw.L: Kwa sababu hiyo inasema: "Baada ya kupanda juu, aliwateka mateka; aliwapa wanadamu zawadi."
sw.B: Ndiyo sababu inasema: "Alipopanda juu sana, aliongoza msafara wa mateka, akawapa wanadamu zawadi."
sw.R: Ndiyo sababu Maandiko yanasema: "Alipopanda mahali palipo juu kabisa, aliteka wafungwa wengi, akawapa watu zawadi."

decisions.choice: Psalm 68:19: God going up in victory; Paul reads "gave gifts" where the psalm says "received gifts"
decisions.reason: Psalm 68 pictures God as a victorious king going up to his holy mountain, leading captives and receiving gifts from people. Paul applies the verse to Christ's going up after his victory, and he has "gave gifts to people" where the Hebrew and the Greek Old Testament both have "received gifts". The psalm itself goes on to God giving to his people (Psalm 68:10-11, 68:36), and a later Aramaic paraphrase of the Psalms also reads "gave". Either way Paul's point is clear: the risen and exalted Christ gives gifts to his people, and verses 11-16 say what they are.

decisions.choice: it says: Scripture says
decisions.reason: The subject of λέγει is not named. Paul often introduces Scripture in this way (5:14); it means "Scripture says" or "God says in Scripture".

decisions.choice: led captivity captive: led a train of captives in triumph
alternatives: he set free those who were held captive
decisions.reason: "Captivity" stands for a group of captives, as in Judges 5:12. In the psalm they are the conquered enemies of God; for Paul they are likely the hostile powers Christ defeated (1:20-22; Colossians 2:15). Some have read them as those Christ set free from captivity, but the psalm's picture is of a conqueror's victory march.

decisions.choice: people: human beings, men and women
decisions.reason: ἀνθρώποις is the general word for human beings, and the gifts of verse 11 go to the church as a whole.

decisions.choice: went up; led a band of captives / took many prisoners
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use plain verbs for "ascended" and say what "led captivity captive" means (m3).

decisions.choice: Scripture says
decisions.reason: Readable names the subject that the Greek leaves out (m2).

decisions.choice: no gender span: wanadamu (L, B), watu (R)
decisions.reason: The English offers "men" as a traditional alternative. Swahili "wanadamu" and "watu" already include men and women, and the only male alternative, "wanaume", means males and would change the meaning. The same holds for "mtu mzima" (verse 13), "mtu wa kale" (verse 22) and "jirani yake" (verse 25), so the Swahili of this chapter has no gender spans.

source.text: τὸ δὲ Ἀνέβη τί ἐστιν εἰ μὴ ὅτι καὶ κατέβη εἰς τὰ κατώτερα μέρη τῆς γῆς;

records.literal_gloss: The and "He went up" what is it if not that also he went down into the lower parts of the earth?

en.L: Now [this word] "He ascended", what is it, except that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also descended into the lower parts of the earth?
en.B: Now what does "He went up" mean, if not that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had also come down into the lower parts of the earth?
en.R: The words "He went up" must mean that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had first come down, into the lower parts of the earth.

es.L: Y [la palabra] «Subió», ¿qué es, sino que también descendió a las partes inferiores de la tierra?
es.B: Ahora bien, ¿qué significa «Subió», sino que también había bajado a las partes inferiores de la tierra?
es.R: Decir «Subió» quiere decir que antes había bajado, a las partes más bajas de la tierra.

sw.L: Basi [neno hili] "Alipanda", ni nini, isipokuwa kwamba pia alishuka hadi sehemu za chini za dunia?
sw.B: Sasa, "Alipanda" maana yake nini, kama si kwamba alikuwa ameshuka pia hadi sehemu za chini za dunia?
sw.R: Maneno "Alipanda" lazima yamaanishe kwamba kwanza alikuwa ameshuka, hadi sehemu za chini za dunia.

decisions.choice: the lower parts of the earth: left open; most likely the earth itself, below heaven, or the realm of the dead
alternatives: the earth itself (Christ's coming as a man)
the realm of the dead (Christ's death and burial)
Christ's coming back by the Spirit
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean (1) the lower regions, that is, the earth, so that Christ came down from heaven to the earth when he became a man; (2) the lowest parts of the earth, the grave or the realm of the dead, so that Christ went down into death before he rose (Psalm 63:10; Romans 10:7); or (3) Christ coming down again by the Spirit after he went up, at Pentecost. The contrast with "far above all the heavens" (verse 10) fits either of the first two. The text keeps the phrase as it is.

decisions.choice: "He went up" implies that he first came down
decisions.reason: Paul takes one word of the psalm and draws out what it implies: one who goes up must have come down first. The going up is Christ's rise to the Father, after his death and resurrection (1:20).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "he also went down"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts add "first" ("he first went down"), which makes the order explicit. Important early manuscripts do not have it. A few early manuscripts also leave out the word "parts". The meaning is not changed.

decisions.choice: went up; come down
decisions.reason: Plain verbs for "ascended" and "descended", as in verse 8. Literal keeps the older words.

source.text: ὁ καταβὰς αὐτός ἐστιν καὶ ὁ ἀναβὰς ὑπεράνω πάντων τῶν οὐρανῶν, ἵνα πληρώσῃ τὰ πάντα.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] having gone down himself is also the [one] having gone up far above all the heavens, so that he might fill the all things.

en.L: The one who descended is {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} also the one who ascended far above all the heavens, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might fill all things.
en.B: The one who came down is the very same one who went up, far above all the heavens, so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} might fill all things.
en.R: The one who came down is the same one who went up, higher than all the heavens. He did this so that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} would fill everything with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence and power.

es.L: El que descendió es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo también el que ascendió muy por encima de todos los cielos, para llenar todas las cosas.
es.B: El que bajó es el mismo que subió, muy por encima de todos los cielos, para llenarlo todo.
es.R: El que bajó es el mismo que subió, más alto que todos los cielos. Lo hizo para llenarlo todo con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} poder.

sw.L: Yule aliyeshuka ni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} mwenyewe pia aliyepanda juu zaidi ya mbingu zote, ili ajaze vitu vyote.
sw.B: Yule aliyeshuka ndiye yule yule aliyepanda, juu zaidi ya mbingu zote, ili ajaze vitu vyote.
sw.R: Yule aliyeshuka ni yule yule aliyepanda, juu kuliko mbingu zote. Alifanya hivyo ili ajaze kila kitu kwa uwepo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.

decisions.choice: fill all things: fill the whole universe with his presence and rule
decisions.reason: Christ, raised far above every power (1:20-23), fills all things: his rule and presence reach everywhere. The church is his body, "the fullness of him who fills all in all" (1:23), and from his place over all he gives the gifts that follow.

decisions.choice: the one who went down is the same one who went up
decisions.reason: αὐτός stresses that it is one and the same person: the Christ who came down is the Christ who now reigns.

decisions.choice: fill everything with his presence and power
decisions.reason: Readable says what "fill" means here (m1).

source.text: καὶ αὐτὸς ἔδωκεν τοὺς μὲν ἀποστόλους, τοὺς δὲ προφήτας, τοὺς δὲ εὐαγγελιστάς, τοὺς δὲ ποιμένας καὶ διδασκάλους, πρὸς τὸν καταρτισμὸν τῶν ἁγίων εἰς ἔργον διακονίας, εἰς οἰκοδομὴν τοῦ σώματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ, μέχρι καταντήσωμεν οἱ πάντες εἰς τὴν ἑνότητα τῆς πίστεως καὶ τῆς ἐπιγνώσεως τοῦ υἱοῦ τοῦ θεοῦ, εἰς ἄνδρα τέλειον, εἰς μέτρον ἡλικίας τοῦ πληρώματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ, ἵνα μηκέτι ὦμεν νήπιοι, κλυδωνιζόμενοι καὶ περιφερόμενοι παντὶ ἀνέμῳ τῆς διδασκαλίας ἐν τῇ κυβείᾳ τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐν πανουργίᾳ πρὸς τὴν μεθοδείαν τῆς πλάνης, ἀληθεύοντες δὲ ἐν ἀγάπῃ αὐξήσωμεν εἰς αὐτὸν τὰ πάντα, ὅς ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλή, Χριστός, ἐξ οὗ πᾶν τὸ σῶμα συναρμολογούμενον καὶ συμβιβαζόμενον διὰ πάσης ἁφῆς τῆς ἐπιχορηγίας κατ’ ἐνέργειαν ἐν μέτρῳ ἑνὸς ἑκάστου μέρους τὴν αὔξησιν τοῦ σώματος ποιεῖται εἰς οἰκοδομὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἐν ἀγάπῃ.

records.literal_gloss: And he gave the [ones] on one hand apostles, the [ones] and prophets, the [ones] and evangelists, the [ones] and shepherds and teachers, \v 12 toward the equipping of the holy [ones] for work of service, for building up of the body of the Christ, \v 13 until we arrive the all at the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of the God, at man mature, at measure of stature of the fullness of the Christ, \v 14 so that no longer we may be infants, being tossed by waves and being carried around by every wind of the teaching in the dice-playing of the men in craftiness toward the scheming of the deceit, \v 15 being truthful but in love we may grow into him the all things, who is the head, Christ, \v 16 from whom all the body being joined together and being held together through every joint of the supply according to working in measure of one each part the growth of the body makes for building up of itself in love.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} gave some [as] apostles, and some [as] prophets, and some [as] evangelists, and some [as] shepherds and teachers, \v 12 for the equipping of the holy [ones] for [the] work of service, for [the] building up of the body of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, \v 13 until we all arrive at the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, at a mature {{gender:adult|man}}, at [the] measure of [the] stature of the fullness of the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, \v 14 so that we may no longer be infants, tossed by waves and carried around by every wind of teaching, by the trickery of {{gender:people|men}}, by craftiness in the scheming of deceit, \v 15 but speaking truth in love, we may grow into {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} [in] all things, who is the head, {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}, \v 16 from whom the whole body, being joined together and held together through every supporting ligament, according to [the] working in [the] measure of each single part, makes the growth of the body for [the] building up of itself in love.
en.B: It was {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} who gave some to be apostles, some prophets, some evangelists, and some shepherds and teachers. \v 12 He gave them to equip God's holy people for the work of serving, so that the body of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} would be built up, \v 13 until all of us arrive at the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God. Then we will be a mature {{gender:adult|man}}, grown to the full measure of the stature that belongs to the fullness of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. \v 14 We will no longer be infants, thrown about by the waves and driven this way and that by each new wind of teaching, at the mercy of people who play tricks and cunningly scheme to lead others astray. \v 15 Instead, as we speak the truth in love, we must grow in every respect into {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, the head, {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. \v 16 From {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the whole body is joined and held together by every ligament that supplies it. As each part does its own work, the body grows and builds itself up in love.
en.R: He gave some people to be apostles, some to be prophets, some to be evangelists who tell the good news, and some to be shepherds and teachers of God's people. \v 12 He gave them to prepare God's holy people to serve, so that the body of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, the church, would grow strong. \v 13 This will go on until all of us are one in our faith and in knowing the Son of God. Then we will be grown up, like a mature {{gender:adult|man}}, and we will reach the full measure of {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. \v 14 Then we will no longer be like little children. We will not be like a small boat tossed by the waves, pushed one way and then another by every new teaching that blows along. We will not be fooled by people who use clever tricks to lead others the wrong way. \v 15 Instead, we will speak the truth with love, and we will grow up in every way, closer to {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, who is the head of the body. \v 16 Through {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} the whole body is joined and held together, and every joint helps supply what it needs. When each part does its own work, the body grows and builds itself up in love.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mismo dio a unos [como] apóstoles, a otros [como] profetas, a otros [como] evangelistas, a otros [como] pastores y maestros, \v 12 para la capacitación de los santos para [la] obra de servicio, para [la] edificación del cuerpo {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, \v 13 hasta que todos lleguemos a la unidad de la fe y del conocimiento del Hijo de Dios, a un {{gender:adulto|varón}} maduro, a [la] medida de [la] estatura de la plenitud {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, \v 14 para que ya no seamos niños, sacudidos por las olas y llevados de un lado a otro por todo viento de enseñanza, por el juego tramposo de {{gender:la gente|los hombres}}, por la astucia en las maquinaciones del error, \v 15 sino que, hablando la verdad en amor, crezcamos en todo hacia {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, el cual es la cabeza, {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}, \v 16 de quien todo el cuerpo, siendo ensamblado y mantenido unido por medio de todo ligamento de apoyo, según la acción en la medida de cada parte individual, hace el crecimiento del cuerpo para [la] edificación de sí mismo en amor.
es.B: Fue {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quien dio a unos como apóstoles, a otros como profetas, a otros como evangelistas, y a otros como pastores y maestros. \v 12 Los dio para preparar al pueblo santo de Dios para la obra de servicio, a fin de que el cuerpo {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}} fuera edificado, \v 13 hasta que todos lleguemos a la unidad de la fe y del conocimiento del Hijo de Dios. Entonces seremos como {{gender:un adulto|un hombre}} maduro y llegaremos a la medida completa de la estatura que corresponde a la plenitud {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}. \v 14 Ya no seremos niños pequeños, zarandeados por las olas y arrastrados de aquí para allá por cada nuevo viento de enseñanza, a merced de gente que hace trampas y trama con astucia para extraviar a otros. \v 15 Al contrario, hablando la verdad con amor, debemos crecer en todo hacia {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, la cabeza, {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}. \v 16 Es {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} quien hace que todo el cuerpo se ajuste y se mantenga unido por medio de cada ligamento que lo sostiene. Cuando cada parte hace su propio trabajo, el cuerpo crece y se edifica a sí mismo en amor.
es.R: Él dio a algunas personas para ser apóstoles, a otras para ser profetas, a otras para ser evangelistas que anuncian la buena noticia, y a otras para ser pastores y maestros del pueblo de Dios. \v 12 Los dio para preparar al pueblo santo de Dios para servir, para que el cuerpo {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, que es la iglesia, se hiciera fuerte. \v 13 Esto seguirá así hasta que todos estemos unidos en nuestra fe y en el conocimiento del Hijo de Dios. Entonces habremos crecido, como {{gender:un adulto|un hombre}} maduro, y llegaremos a la medida completa {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}. \v 14 Entonces ya no seremos como niños pequeños. No seremos como una barca pequeña sacudida por las olas, empujada de un lado a otro por cada nueva enseñanza que sopla. No nos dejaremos engañar por gente que usa trucos astutos para desviar a otros del buen camino. \v 15 Al contrario, diremos la verdad con amor, y creceremos en todo, cada vez más cerca {{christos:de Cristo|del Mesías}}, que es la cabeza del cuerpo. \v 16 Gracias a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, todo el cuerpo está unido y bien sostenido, y cada coyuntura ayuda a darle lo que necesita. Cuando cada parte hace su trabajo, el cuerpo crece y se edifica a sí mismo en amor.

sw.L: Na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} mwenyewe alitoa wengine [wawe] mitume, na wengine [wawe] manabii, na wengine [wawe] wainjilisti, na wengine [wawe] wachungaji na walimu, \v 12 kwa ajili ya kuwaandaa watakatifu kwa kazi ya huduma, kwa ajili ya kujenga mwili wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, \v 13 mpaka sisi sote tufikie umoja wa imani na wa kumjua Mwana wa Mungu, tufikie [hali ya] mtu mzima kamili, tufikie kipimo cha kimo cha utimilifu wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, \v 14 ili tusiwe tena watoto wachanga, tukisukwasukwa na mawimbi na kuchukuliwa kila upande na kila upepo wa mafundisho, kwa michezo ya hila ya wanadamu, kwa werevu katika mbinu za upotoshaji, \v 15 bali tukisema kweli katika upendo, tukue kuelekea {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} katika mambo yote, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliye kichwa, {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, \v 16 ambaye kutoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} mwili wote, ukiungwa na kushikiliwa pamoja kupitia kila kano inayoutegemeza, kwa kadiri ya utendaji katika kipimo cha kila sehemu moja moja, huleta ukuaji wa mwili kwa ajili ya kujijenga wenyewe katika upendo.
sw.B: Ni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliyewatoa wengine wawe mitume, wengine manabii, wengine wainjilisti, na wengine wachungaji na walimu. \v 12 Aliwatoa ili wawaandae watakatifu wa Mungu kwa kazi ya kuhudumu, ili mwili wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} ujengwe, \v 13 mpaka sisi sote tufikie umoja wa imani na wa kumjua Mwana wa Mungu. Hapo tutakuwa mtu mzima aliyekomaa, tukiwa tumekua hadi kufikia kipimo kamili cha kimo kinachotokana na utimilifu wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. \v 14 Hatutakuwa tena watoto wachanga, tukisukwasukwa na mawimbi na kupelekwa kila upande na kila upepo mpya wa mafundisho, tukiwa mikononi mwa watu wanaocheza hila na kupanga kwa werevu jinsi ya kuwapotosha wengine. \v 15 Badala yake, tukisema kweli kwa upendo, inatupasa kukua katika kila hali kuelekea {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliye kichwa, {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. \v 16 Kutoka {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}} mwili wote unaungwa na kushikiliwa pamoja na kila kano inayoupa msaada. Kila sehemu inapofanya kazi yake, mwili hukua na kujijenga wenyewe katika upendo.
sw.R: Yeye aliwatoa watu fulani wawe mitume, wengine wawe manabii, wengine wawe wainjilisti wanaohubiri Habari Njema, na wengine wawe wachungaji na walimu wa watu wa Mungu. \v 12 Aliwatoa ili wawaandae watu wa Mungu walio watakatifu kwa kazi ya kuhudumu, ili mwili wa {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, yaani kanisa, upate nguvu. \v 13 Hali hii itaendelea mpaka sisi sote tuwe wamoja katika imani yetu na katika kumjua Mwana wa Mungu. Hapo tutakuwa tumekomaa, kama mtu mzima, na tutafikia kipimo kamili cha {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. \v 14 Hapo hatutakuwa tena kama watoto wadogo. Hatutakuwa kama mashua ndogo inayorushwa na mawimbi, ikisukumwa huku na kule na kila fundisho jipya linalovuma. Hatutadanganywa na watu wanaotumia hila za werevu kuwapeleka wengine njia mbaya. \v 15 Badala yake, tutasema kweli kwa upendo, nasi tutakua kwa kila namna, tukizidi kumkaribia {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, aliye kichwa cha mwili. \v 16 Kupitia {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} mwili wote umeungwa na kushikiliwa pamoja, na kila kiungo husaidia kuupa mwili kile unachohitaji. Kila sehemu inapofanya kazi yake, mwili hukua na kujijenga wenyewe katika upendo.

decisions.choice: he gave some as apostles...: the gifts of verse 8 are people
decisions.reason: αὐτὸς picks up "he gave gifts" from the psalm (verse 8): the gifts Christ gives his church are people given to serve it. The list names gifted people, not only their abilities.

decisions.choice: apostles, prophets, evangelists
decisions.reason: Apostles were those sent by the risen Christ with his authority (1:1). Prophets spoke messages given by God to the church; with the apostles they are the church's foundation (2:20; 3:5). Evangelists proclaimed the gospel, especially where it had not been heard (Acts 21:8; 2 Timothy 4:5).

decisions.choice: shepherds and teachers: one group with two closely joined tasks, or two closely linked groups
decisions.reason: The other names each have their own article (τοὺς), but one article covers both ποιμένας and διδασκάλους. This joins them closely: those who care for God's people as shepherds also teach them, though not every teacher need be a shepherd. Shepherding is the Bible's picture for leaders who care for God's people (Acts 20:28; 1 Peter 5:2).

decisions.choice: Christ gave these people to equip the saints for works of service, with the building up of the body as the goal
alternatives: three parallel purposes of the leaders: to equip the saints, to do the work of ministry, to build up the body
decisions.reason: The three phrases are not parallel. The first uses πρὸς, the next two εἰς: the leaders equip God's holy people, so that the people do the work of service, and so the body is built up. Some readings put a comma after "saints" and make three parallel tasks of the leaders: equipping the saints, doing the work of ministry, building up the body. The change of preposition, and verse 16, where every part does its work, favor the reading that gives the work of service to all God's people.

decisions.choice: equipping: preparing and making fit
decisions.reason: καταρτισμὸν comes from a verb used of mending nets (Mark 1:19) and of making something complete and ready for use. The leaders' task is to make God's people ready for their work.

decisions.choice: a mature man: the whole church grown to adulthood, not maleness
decisions.reason: ἄνδρα is the word for a grown man, chosen here because it is the opposite of "infants" in verse 14. The contrast is between childhood and full-grown maturity. It is one figure for the whole church together, not for each person alone.

decisions.choice: the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ: maturity measured by Christ in his fullness
decisions.reason: ἡλικίας can mean age or bodily height; either way the picture is of growing up. The standard is not a human one: the church is to grow until it matches the full measure of Christ.

decisions.choice: the unity of the faith: the oneness that comes from sharing one faith
decisions.reason: The faith here is the shared trust in Christ, as in verse 5, together with the knowledge of him. The unity of the Spirit already exists (verse 3); this unity is reached as the church grows.

decisions.choice: infants tossed by waves and every wind of teaching: unstable and easily led astray
decisions.reason: The picture is of a small boat at sea, thrown about by every change of wind. κυβείᾳ means dice-playing, and came to mean trickery and cheating; πανουργίᾳ is cunning, and μεθοδείαν scheming (the same word as "the schemes of the devil", 6:11).

decisions.choice: speaking the truth: being truthful in word and life
decisions.reason: ἀληθεύοντες means speaking the truth, and with it holding to the truth, in contrast to the deceit of verse 14. It is done in love.

decisions.choice: grow into him: grow toward Christ, the head, and become more fully joined to him
decisions.reason: The body grows up into its head: the church grows toward Christ and comes to match him more fully. "In all things" means in every way.

decisions.choice: the body's growth comes from Christ, through every part working
decisions.reason: Christ is the source of the growth ("from whom"). The body is fitted and held together by every ligament (ἁφῆς) that supplies it, as each part works. Colossians 2:19 uses the same picture.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article where the Greek has it.

decisions.choice: a mature {{gender:adult|man}}
decisions.reason: The figure is about adulthood, not being male (m6). "Adult" is the default; "man" is the traditional form.

decisions.choice: shepherds
decisions.reason: The Greek word means shepherds. "Pastors" comes from the Latin word for shepherd, but it now names a church office and loses the picture.

decisions.choice: evangelists who tell the good news; the church
decisions.reason: Readable says what evangelists do (m2) and who the body is.

decisions.choice: like a small boat
decisions.reason: Readable names the picture behind "tossed by waves" (m9).

decisions.choice: pastores
decisions.reason: Spanish "pastor" is both the ordinary word for a shepherd and the church title, so "pastores" keeps the Greek picture at every level, which the English keeps with "shepherds" (r-en-3).

decisions.choice: {{gender:adulto|varón}} (L); {{gender:un adulto|un hombre}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The figure is adulthood against childhood, not maleness (m6). "Adulto" is used of men and women; "varón" (Literal, the word for a male) and "hombre" are the traditional alternatives. "Maduro" says τέλειον as grown-up, not flawless.

decisions.choice: wachungaji
decisions.reason: Swahili "mchungaji" is both a herder and the church's pastor, so it keeps the shepherd picture at every level, as the English "shepherds" does (r-en-3).

decisions.choice: mtu mzima, no gender span
decisions.reason: "Mtu mzima" is the ordinary Swahili for an adult, man or woman, which is the figure here: grown-up against "watoto wachanga" (m6). It needs no setting. "Mkamilifu" would suggest moral perfection rather than maturity.

source.text: Τοῦτο οὖν λέγω καὶ μαρτύρομαι ἐν κυρίῳ, μηκέτι ὑμᾶς περιπατεῖν καθὼς καὶ τὰ ἔθνη περιπατεῖ ἐν ματαιότητι τοῦ νοὸς αὐτῶν, ἐσκοτωμένοι τῇ διανοίᾳ ὄντες, ἀπηλλοτριωμένοι τῆς ζωῆς τοῦ θεοῦ, διὰ τὴν ἄγνοιαν τὴν οὖσαν ἐν αὐτοῖς, διὰ τὴν πώρωσιν τῆς καρδίας αὐτῶν, οἵτινες ἀπηλγηκότες ἑαυτοὺς παρέδωκαν τῇ ἀσελγείᾳ εἰς ἐργασίαν ἀκαθαρσίας πάσης ἐν πλεονεξίᾳ.

records.literal_gloss: This therefore I say and testify in [the] Lord, no longer you to walk as also the Gentiles walk in futility of the mind of them, \v 18 having been darkened in the understanding being, having been alienated from the life of the God, because of the ignorance the being in them, because of the hardness of the heart of them, \v 19 who having become callous themselves gave over to the sensuality for [the] working of impurity of all in greed.

en.L: This, therefore, I say and testify in [the] Lord: [that] you no longer walk as the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind, \v 18 being darkened in [their] understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardness of their heart; \v 19 [they are people] who, having become callous, gave themselves over to sensuality, for the practice of every impurity, with greed.
en.B: So I tell you this, and insist on it in the Lord: you must no longer live as the Gentiles live, with their futile, empty thinking. \v 18 Their understanding is darkened, and they are cut off from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because their hearts have grown hard. \v 19 They have lost all feeling and have given themselves over to indecency, practicing every kind of impurity with an appetite that always wants more.
en.R: So I tell you this, and I say it with the Lord's authority: do not live any longer like the Gentiles, the people who do not know God. Their thoughts are empty and lead nowhere. \v 18 Their minds are in the dark. They are far away from the life that God gives, because they do not know {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and their hearts have become hard. \v 19 They no longer feel shame. They have given themselves over to shameless living. They do every kind of impure thing, and they always want more.

es.L: Esto, pues, digo y testifico en [el] Señor: que ya no {{plural_you:anden|andéis}} como también andan los gentiles, en la vanidad de su mente, \v 18 estando entenebrecidos en [su] entendimiento, ajenos a la vida de Dios por la ignorancia que hay en ellos, por la dureza de su corazón; \v 19 [ellos son] los que, habiendo perdido toda sensibilidad, se entregaron a la sensualidad, para la práctica de toda impureza, con avidez.
es.B: Así que {{plural_you:les|os}} digo esto, y lo afirmo en el Señor: ya no {{plural_you:deben|debéis}} vivir como viven los gentiles, con su pensamiento vacío e inútil. \v 18 Tienen el entendimiento oscurecido y están apartados de la vida de Dios por la ignorancia que hay en ellos, porque su corazón se ha endurecido. \v 19 Han perdido toda sensibilidad y se han entregado al libertinaje, practicando toda clase de impureza con un apetito que siempre quiere más.
es.R: Por eso {{plural_you:les|os}} digo esto, y lo digo con la autoridad del Señor: no {{plural_you:vivan|viváis}} más como los gentiles, la gente que no conoce a Dios. Sus pensamientos están vacíos y no llevan a ninguna parte. \v 18 Su mente está a oscuras. Están lejos de la vida que Dios da, porque no {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} conocen y su corazón se ha endurecido. \v 19 Ya no sienten vergüenza. Se han entregado a una vida sin pudor. Hacen toda clase de cosas impuras y siempre quieren más.

sw.L: Basi ninasema jambo hili na kulishuhudia katika Bwana: msienende tena kama watu wa mataifa nao wanavyoenenda, katika utupu wa akili zao, \v 18 wakiwa wametiwa giza katika ufahamu [wao], wakiwa wamefanywa wageni kwa uzima wa Mungu kwa sababu ya kutojua kulikomo ndani yao, kwa sababu ya ugumu wa moyo wao; \v 19 [hao ni watu] ambao, baada ya kupoteza hisia, walijikabidhi kwa ufasiki, ili kutenda uchafu wa kila aina kwa tamaa ya kupata zaidi.
sw.B: Kwa hiyo nawaambia jambo hili, na kulisisitiza katika Bwana: msiishi tena kama watu wa mataifa wanavyoishi, wakiwa na mawazo matupu yasiyo na maana. \v 18 Ufahamu wao umetiwa giza, nao wametengwa mbali na uzima wa Mungu kwa sababu ya ujinga ulio ndani yao, kwa sababu mioyo yao imekuwa migumu. \v 19 Wamepoteza hisia zote, nao wamejitoa kwa ufasiki, wakitenda kila aina ya uchafu kwa tamaa isiyotosheka kamwe.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo nawaambia jambo hili, nami nalisema kwa mamlaka ya Bwana: msiishi tena kama watu wa mataifa, watu wasiomjua Mungu. Mawazo yao ni matupu, hayawafikishi popote. \v 18 Akili zao ziko gizani. Wako mbali na uzima ambao Mungu hutoa, kwa sababu hawamjui, na mioyo yao imekuwa migumu. \v 19 Hawaoni tena aibu. Wamejitoa kuishi maisha ya aibu bila kujizuia. Wanafanya kila aina ya mambo machafu, na siku zote wanataka zaidi.

decisions.choice: the Gentiles: the nations who do not know God
decisions.reason: τὰ ἔθνη means the non-Jewish nations. The readers were Gentiles by birth (2:11; 3:1), but they now belong to God's people; here the word means those who still live without God (2:12).

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "as the Gentiles also walk"
alternatives: "as the rest of the Gentiles walk"
decisions.reason: Many later manuscripts read "as the rest of the Gentiles walk", which counts the readers among the Gentiles. Important early manuscripts do not have "the rest".

decisions.choice: the futility of their mind: thinking that is empty and leads to nothing
decisions.reason: ματαιότητι is emptiness, what has no result or purpose. It is the word used of human thinking that has turned from God (Romans 1:21; 8:20).

decisions.choice: cut off from the life of God because of ignorance and hardness of heart
decisions.reason: The life of God is the life that God has and gives. They are shut out from it because they do not know God, and they do not know him because their hearts have grown hard. πώρωσιν means a hardening, as of skin or bone, that makes a person unable to feel or respond (Mark 3:5; Romans 11:25).

decisions.choice: callous, sensuality, greed
decisions.reason: ἀπηλγηκότες means having stopped feeling pain, past caring. ἀσελγείᾳ is open, shameless indecency without restraint. πλεονεξίᾳ is the craving to have more and more; it can include sexual greed, since it stands beside "impurity" (5:3; Colossians 3:5).

decisions.choice: cut off from the life of God; an appetite that always wants more
decisions.reason: Balanced uses plain words for "alienated" and "greed" (m4, m5).

decisions.choice: the people who do not know God; because they do not know him
decisions.reason: Readable explains who the Gentiles are here (m1) and what their ignorance is (m4).

decisions.choice: I say it with the Lord's authority
decisions.reason: Readable says what "testify in the Lord" means: Paul speaks as one who belongs to the Lord and with his authority.

decisions.choice: los gentiles, la gente que no conoce a Dios
decisions.reason: Readable usually says "los que no son judíos" for the Gentiles, but the readers were not Jews either (m1): here the word means people who live without God. So Readable keeps "gentiles" and explains it, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: watu wa mataifa, watu wasiomjua Mungu
decisions.reason: Readable usually says "watu wasio Wayahudi" for the Gentiles, but the readers were not Jews either (m1): here the word means people who live without God. So Readable keeps "watu wa mataifa" and explains it, as the English Readable does.

source.text: ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐχ οὕτως ἐμάθετε τὸν Χριστόν, εἴ γε αὐτὸν ἠκούσατε καὶ ἐν αὐτῷ ἐδιδάχθητε, καθώς ἐστιν ἀλήθεια ἐν τῷ Ἰησοῦ, ἀποθέσθαι ὑμᾶς κατὰ τὴν προτέραν ἀναστροφὴν τὸν παλαιὸν ἄνθρωπον τὸν φθειρόμενον κατὰ τὰς ἐπιθυμίας τῆς ἀπάτης, ἀνανεοῦσθαι δὲ τῷ πνεύματι τοῦ νοὸς ὑμῶν, καὶ ἐνδύσασθαι τὸν καινὸν ἄνθρωπον τὸν κατὰ θεὸν κτισθέντα ἐν δικαιοσύνῃ καὶ ὁσιότητι τῆς ἀληθείας.

records.literal_gloss: You but not so learned the Christ, \v 21 if indeed him you heard and in him you were taught, as is truth in the Jesus, \v 22 to put off you according to the former way of life the old man the [one] being corrupted according to the desires of the deceit, \v 23 to be renewed and in the spirit of the mind of you, \v 24 and to put on the new man the [one] according to God having been created in righteousness and holiness of the truth.

en.L: But you did not learn the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} in this way, \v 21 if indeed you heard {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and were taught in {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, as [the] truth is in Jesus: \v 22 that you put off, as concerns [your] former way of life, the old self, which is being corrupted according to the desires of deceit, \v 23 and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind, \v 24 and put on the new self, created according to God in righteousness and holiness of the truth.
en.B: But that is not how you learned {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. \v 21 You surely heard {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and were taught as people who belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, in keeping with the truth that is in Jesus. \v 22 You were taught to strip off the old self, the self of your former way of life, which is being ruined by its deceitful desires; \v 23 to be made new in the spirit of your minds; \v 24 and to put on the new self, created in God's likeness, in the righteousness and holiness that come from the truth.
en.R: But that is not what you learned when you came to know {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}. \v 21 You heard {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, and you were taught as people who belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. You learned the truth that is in Jesus. \v 22 You were taught to take off your old self, the way you used to live, like old clothes. That old self is being ruined by desires that trick you. \v 23 You were taught to let God make your thinking new, \v 24 and to put on the new self. God created this new self to be like {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. It is righteous and holy, because it comes from the truth.

es.L: Pero {{plural_you:ustedes no aprendieron|vosotros no aprendisteis}} así {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}, \v 21 si es que de veras {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:oyeron|oísteis}} y en {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} enseñados, así como la verdad está en Jesús: \v 22 que {{plural_you:se despojen|os despojéis}}, en cuanto a la antigua manera de vivir, del viejo {{gender:ser humano|hombre}}, que se va corrompiendo conforme a los deseos del engaño, \v 23 y que {{plural_you:sean|seáis}} renovados en el espíritu de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} mente, \v 24 y que {{plural_you:se revistan|os revistáis}} del nuevo {{gender:ser humano|hombre}}, creado según Dios en justicia y santidad de la verdad.
es.B: Pero no es así como {{plural_you:ustedes aprendieron|vosotros aprendisteis}} {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}. \v 21 Sin duda {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:oyeron|oísteis}} y {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} enseñados como personas que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenecen, de acuerdo con la verdad que está en Jesús. \v 22 Se {{plural_you:les|os}} enseñó a {{plural_you:despojarse|despojaros}} del viejo yo, el de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} antigua manera de vivir, que se va arruinando por sus deseos engañosos; \v 23 a {{plural_you:dejarse|dejaros}} renovar en el espíritu de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} mente; \v 24 y a {{plural_you:revestirse|revestiros}} del nuevo yo, creado a semejanza de Dios, en la justicia y la santidad que vienen de la verdad.
es.R: Pero no es eso lo que {{plural_you:aprendieron|aprendisteis}} cuando {{plural_you:conocieron|conocisteis}} {{christos:a Cristo|al Mesías}}. \v 21 {{plural_you:Ustedes|Vosotros}} {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} {{plural_you:escucharon|escuchasteis}} y {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} enseñados como personas que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenecen. {{plural_you:Aprendieron|Aprendisteis}} la verdad que está en Jesús. \v 22 Se {{plural_you:les|os}} enseñó a {{plural_you:quitarse|quitaros}} el viejo yo, la manera en que {{plural_you:vivían|vivíais}} antes, como quien se quita ropa vieja. Ese viejo yo se va arruinando por deseos que {{plural_you:los|os}} engañan. \v 23 Se {{plural_you:les|os}} enseñó a dejar que Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} renueve la manera de pensar, \v 24 y a {{plural_you:ponerse|poneros}} el nuevo yo. Dios creó ese nuevo yo para que se pareciera a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. Es justo y santo, porque viene de la verdad.

sw.L: Lakini ninyi hamkujifunza {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} kwa jinsi hii, \v 21 ikiwa hakika mlimsikia na mkafundishwa ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kwa jinsi kweli ilivyo ndani ya Yesu: \v 22 kwamba mjivue, kuhusu mwenendo wa zamani, mtu wa kale anayeoza kwa kufuata tamaa za hila, \v 23 na mfanywe wapya katika roho ya akili zenu, \v 24 na mjivike mtu mpya, aliyeumbwa kulingana na Mungu katika haki na utakatifu wa ile kweli.
sw.B: Lakini sivyo mlivyojifunza {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. \v 21 Hakika mlimsikia, na mlifundishwa kama watu walio {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, kulingana na kweli iliyo ndani ya Yesu. \v 22 Mlifundishwa kuuvua utu wa zamani, utu wa mwenendo wenu wa awali, ambao unaharibiwa na tamaa zake za udanganyifu; \v 23 kufanywa upya katika roho ya akili zenu; \v 24 na kuuvaa utu mpya, ulioumbwa kwa mfano wa Mungu, katika haki na utakatifu unaotokana na kweli.
sw.R: Lakini sivyo mlivyojifunza mlipomjua {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}. \v 21 Mlimsikia, na mlifundishwa kama watu walio {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Mlijifunza kweli iliyo ndani ya Yesu. \v 22 Mlifundishwa kuuvua utu wenu wa zamani, jinsi mlivyoishi zamani, kama mtu anavyovua nguo kuukuu. Utu huo wa zamani unaharibiwa na tamaa zinazowadanganya. \v 23 Mlifundishwa kumruhusu Mungu afanye upya fikira zenu, \v 24 na kuuvaa utu mpya. Mungu aliuumba utu huo mpya ili ufanane na {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}. Ni utu wenye haki na mtakatifu, kwa sababu unatokana na kweli.

decisions.choice: learn Christ: come to know Christ himself, not only facts about him
decisions.reason: Paul speaks of learning a person. To learn Christ is to receive him as Lord and to be taught his way of life (Colossians 2:6-7); it rules out the way of life just described.

decisions.choice: if indeed: assuming, as is true, that you heard him
decisions.reason: εἴ γε does not doubt that they heard; it appeals to what they know (3:2). They heard Christ himself speaking through those who brought them the gospel, and were taught as people joined to him.

decisions.choice: as truth is in Jesus: the teaching they received matches the truth found in Jesus
decisions.reason: Paul uses the name Jesus alone, pointing to the man Jesus and his life: the truth is seen in him, and what they were taught agrees with it.

decisions.choice: put off, be renewed, put on: what they were taught, which they are to live out
alternatives: a past fact: you have put off the old self and put on the new
a command: put off the old self and put on the new
decisions.reason: The three verbs are infinitives depending on "you were taught" (verse 21): they give the content of the teaching. They can be read as stating what happened when the readers came to Christ (as Colossians 3:9-10 does: "you have put off the old self"), or as what they were taught to keep doing, with the force of a command. The first and last verbs are aorist, a decisive act; the middle one, "be renewed", is present, an ongoing process. Either way the teaching shapes how they must now live (verse 25).

decisions.choice: the old self: the person one was without Christ, ruled by the old way of life
decisions.reason: The old "man" is the whole person as he or she was before Christ, belonging to the old humanity (Romans 6:6; Colossians 3:9). It is "being corrupted": it is going to ruin, led by desires that deceive.

decisions.choice: the spirit of your mind: the inner attitude that directs the mind
alternatives: by the Spirit, in your mind
decisions.reason: Here πνεύματι most likely means the human spirit, the inner self that gives the mind its direction; God renews it (the verb is passive). Some read it as the Holy Spirit renewing the mind, but the phrase "of your mind" points to the human spirit.

decisions.choice: the new self, created according to God: made in God's likeness, Genesis 1:26-27
decisions.reason: κατὰ θεὸν means in the pattern of God, after his likeness. As in Colossians 3:10, the new self is a new creation in the image of its creator (2:10, 2:15).

decisions.choice: righteousness and holiness of the truth: righteousness and holiness that belong to the truth
decisions.reason: The phrase stands against "the desires of deceit" (verse 22). The new self's righteousness and holiness are real and come from the truth that is in Jesus (verse 21). It can also be read as "true righteousness and holiness".

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting. Literal keeps the article: "the {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}".

decisions.choice: the old self; the new self
decisions.reason: The Greek says "the old man" and "the new man", but ἄνθρωπον here means a human being, of either sex (m5); "self" says this without a setting. Colossians 3:9-10 has the same words.

decisions.choice: You were taught to strip off... to be made new... to put on
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable repeat "you were taught" so that the three verbs read as its content, as in the Greek (m4).

decisions.choice: like old clothes; let God make your thinking new
decisions.reason: Readable names the clothing picture in "put off" and "put on", and God as the one who renews (m6).

decisions.choice: el viejo {{gender:ser humano|hombre}}, el nuevo {{gender:ser humano|hombre}} (L); el viejo yo, el nuevo yo (B, R)
alternatives: la vieja naturaleza, la nueva naturaleza
el hombre viejo, el hombre nuevo at every level
decisions.reason: ἄνθρωπον is a human being of either sex (m5). Literal keeps the noun as "ser humano", with the traditional "hombre" as the gender alternative. Balanced and Readable say "el viejo yo" and "el nuevo yo" (the old and the new self), which, like the English "self", needs no setting and keeps the picture of one person taking off and putting on clothes.

decisions.choice: mtu wa kale, mtu mpya (L); utu wa zamani, utu mpya (B, R)
alternatives: mtu wa zamani at every level
decisions.reason: ἄνθρωπον is "mtu", a human being of either sex (m5), so Literal keeps "mtu". Balanced and Readable say "utu", a person's whole self and character, which says "self" as the English does. Both take the verbs of clothing, "kuvua" and "kuvaa", so the picture stays.

source.text: Διὸ ἀποθέμενοι τὸ ψεῦδος λαλεῖτε ἀλήθειαν ἕκαστος μετὰ τοῦ πλησίον αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἐσμὲν ἀλλήλων μέλη.

records.literal_gloss: Therefore having put off the falsehood speak truth each with the neighbor of him, because we are of one another members.

en.L: Therefore, having put off falsehood, speak truth, each [one] with {{gender:their|his}} neighbor, for we are members of one another.
en.B: So now that you have stripped off falsehood, each of you must tell your neighbor the truth, for we are members of one another.
en.R: So stop telling lies. Each of you must tell the truth to the people around you, because we all belong to each other, like parts of one body.

es.L: Por lo cual, {{plural_you:habiéndose despojado|habiéndoos despojado}} de la mentira, {{plural_you:hablen|hablad}} verdad cada uno con su prójimo, porque somos miembros los unos de los otros.
es.B: Así que ahora que {{plural_you:se han despojado|os habéis despojado}} de la mentira, cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} debe decir la verdad a su prójimo, porque somos miembros unos de otros.
es.R: Así que {{plural_you:dejen|dejad}} de decir mentiras. Cada uno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} debe decir la verdad a los que tiene cerca, porque todos nos pertenecemos unos a otros, como partes de un mismo cuerpo.

sw.L: Kwa hiyo, mkiisha kuuvua uongo, semeni kweli kila mmoja pamoja na jirani yake, kwa kuwa sisi ni viungo sisi kwa sisi.
sw.B: Basi sasa kwa kuwa mmeuvua uongo, kila mmoja wenu amwambie jirani yake kweli, kwa maana sisi kwa sisi ni viungo.
sw.R: Kwa hiyo acheni kusema uongo. Kila mmoja wenu aseme kweli kwa watu walio karibu naye, kwa sababu sisi sote tumeunganishwa pamoja, kama viungo vya mwili mmoja.

decisions.choice: speak truth each with his neighbor: Zechariah 8:16
decisions.reason: Paul's words follow Zechariah 8:16 closely, where God tells his restored people to speak truth to one another. Paul does not mark it as a quotation; it is the command Israel was given, now given to the church. The neighbor here is above all the fellow believer, as the reason given shows.

decisions.choice: having put off falsehood: having taken off lying like old clothes
decisions.reason: ἀποθέμενοι is the same verb as "put off" in verse 22. Falsehood belongs to the old self they have stripped off; speaking truth belongs to the new self, created "in the holiness of the truth" (verse 24).

decisions.choice: members of one another: parts of one body, belonging to each other
decisions.reason: "Members" are the parts of a body (verse 16; Romans 12:5). To lie to a fellow believer is like one part of a body deceiving another.

decisions.choice: {{gender:their|his}}
decisions.reason: Each one, man or woman, is meant; "his" is the traditional form.

decisions.choice: like parts of one body
decisions.reason: Readable explains "members" (m3).

decisions.choice: su prójimo, no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "su" is the same for his and her, so the English span ({{gender:their|his}}) has nothing to change here. In verse 28 "quien roba" is likewise neither masculine nor feminine.

source.text: ὀργίζεσθε καὶ μὴ ἁμαρτάνετε· ὁ ἥλιος μὴ ἐπιδυέτω ἐπὶ παροργισμῷ ὑμῶν, μηδὲ δίδοτε τόπον τῷ διαβόλῳ.

records.literal_gloss: Be angry and not sin; the sun not let set upon anger of you, \v 27 nor give place to the devil.

en.L: Be angry and do not sin; let the sun not set upon your anger, \v 27 nor give room to the devil.
en.B: If you become angry, do not let it lead you into sin. Do not let the sunset find you still angry, \v 27 and do not give the devil an opening.
en.R: When you are angry, do not let your anger lead you to sin. Deal with your anger before the day is over. \v 27 Do not give the devil any room to work.

es.L: {{plural_you:Aírense|Airaos}}, y no {{plural_you:pequen|pequéis}}; que el sol no se ponga sobre {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} enojo, \v 27 ni {{plural_you:den|deis}} lugar al diablo.
es.B: Si {{plural_you:se enojan|os enojáis}}, no {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que eso {{plural_you:los|os}} lleve a pecar. Que la puesta del sol no {{plural_you:los|os}} encuentre todavía enojados, \v 27 y no le {{plural_you:den|deis}} al diablo una oportunidad.
es.R: Cuando {{plural_you:se enojen|os enojéis}}, no {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que el enojo {{plural_you:los|os}} lleve a pecar. {{plural_you:Resuelvan|Resolved}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} enojo antes de que termine el día. \v 27 No le {{plural_you:den|deis}} al diablo ningún espacio para actuar.

sw.L: Kasirikeni na msitende dhambi; jua lisizame juu ya hasira yenu, \v 27 wala msimpatie Ibilisi nafasi.
sw.B: Mkikasirika, msiruhusu hasira hiyo iwapeleke kwenye dhambi. Jua lisizame mkiwa bado na hasira, \v 27 na msimpe Ibilisi mwanya.
sw.R: Mnapokasirika, msiache hasira yenu iwafanye mtende dhambi. Shughulikieni hasira yenu kabla siku haijaisha. \v 27 Msimpe Ibilisi nafasi yoyote ya kufanya kazi yake.

decisions.choice: be angry and do not sin: Psalm 4:5, in the words of the Greek Old Testament
decisions.reason: The first words are exactly those of Psalm 4:5 in the Greek translation of the Old Testament. The Hebrew verb there means to tremble or be stirred, with fear or with anger.

decisions.choice: be angry and do not sin: anger is allowed for, but the command is not to sin in it
alternatives: a command to be angry at what is wrong
decisions.reason: The weight of the sentence is on "do not sin". Paul does not order the readers to be angry; he grants that anger will come and forbids letting it turn into sin. Verse 31 tells them to put away anger of the sinful kind.

decisions.choice: let the sun not set on your anger: do not keep your anger past the end of the day
decisions.reason: The day ended at sunset (compare Deuteronomy 24:15). Anger kept overnight becomes resentment. παροργισμῷ is anger that has been stirred up, a fit of anger.

decisions.choice: give place to the devil: give the devil an opportunity
decisions.reason: τόπον means a place, and so a chance or opening. Anger nursed and kept gives the devil a way in to do harm in the church.

decisions.choice: If you become angry / When you are angry, do not let it lead you into sin
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable state the sense of the command (m2), so that it is not read as an order to be angry. Literal keeps the form.

decisions.choice: Deal with your anger before the day is over
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture of the sunset means (m3).

decisions.choice: airarse (L); enojarse, enojo (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "airarse", the older verb that goes with "ira", so the words of Psalm 4:5 stay recognisable (m1). Balanced and Readable use "enojarse", the everyday verb, for anger that may come but must not turn into sin (m2).

source.text: ὁ κλέπτων μηκέτι κλεπτέτω, μᾶλλον δὲ κοπιάτω ἐργαζόμενος ταῖς ἰδίαις χερσὶν τὸ ἀγαθόν, ἵνα ἔχῃ μεταδιδόναι τῷ χρείαν ἔχοντι.

records.literal_gloss: The [one] stealing no longer let steal, rather but let toil working with the own hands the good, so that may have to share with the [one] need having.

en.L: Let the one who steals steal no longer, but rather let {{gender:them|him}} toil, working what is good with {{gender:their|his}} own hands, so that {{gender:they|he}} may have [something] to share with the one who has need.
en.B: Thieves must steal no more. Instead they must work hard, doing something good with their own hands, so that they have something to share with anyone in need.
en.R: If you have been stealing, stop. Work hard and do honest, useful work with your own hands. Then you will have something to give to people who are in need.

es.L: Quien roba, que ya no robe; más bien, que se afane trabajando con sus propias manos en lo que es bueno, para que tenga [algo] que compartir con quien tiene necesidad.
es.B: Quienes roban, que no roben más. Al contrario, que trabajen duro, haciendo algo bueno con sus propias manos, para tener algo que compartir con cualquiera que pase necesidad.
es.R: Si alguno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ha estado robando, que deje de hacerlo. Que trabaje duro y haga un trabajo honrado y útil con sus propias manos. Así tendrá algo que dar a los que pasan necesidad.

sw.L: Yeye aibaye asiibe tena; bali zaidi sana afanye kazi kwa bidii, akitenda lililo jema kwa mikono yake mwenyewe, ili awe na [kitu] cha kumgawia mhitaji.
sw.B: Wezi wasiibe tena. Badala yake wafanye kazi kwa bidii, wakitenda jambo jema kwa mikono yao wenyewe, ili wawe na kitu cha kuwagawia wenye mahitaji.
sw.R: Kama mmekuwa mkiiba, acheni. Fanyeni kazi kwa bidii, kazi ya halali na yenye manufaa, kwa mikono yenu wenyewe. Hapo mtakuwa na kitu cha kuwapa watu wenye shida.

decisions.choice: the one who steals: anyone who has been stealing
decisions.reason: κλέπτων is a present participle: the one who has been in the habit of stealing. Paul speaks to anyone in the church, man or woman, whose old life included theft.

decisions.choice: toil, working what is good: hard, honest work
decisions.reason: κοπιάτω is to work to the point of weariness. "What is good" is useful, honest work in place of theft. Paul worked with his own hands too (1 Thessalonians 4:11; Acts 20:34-35).

decisions.choice: so that he may have something to share: the purpose of work is also giving
decisions.reason: The former thief, who took from others, is now to work so that he or she can give to others. The aim is not only to stop wrongdoing but to do its opposite.

decisions.choice: {{gender:them|him}}; {{gender:their|his}}; {{gender:they|he}}
decisions.reason: Anyone is meant (m1); the masculine forms are the traditional alternative.

decisions.choice: Thieves... they
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the sentence in the plural, which means the same and needs no gender setting.

decisions.choice: If you have been stealing, stop
decisions.reason: Readable speaks to the reader directly, as the rest of the passage does. The sense is the same.

decisions.choice: Si alguno de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} ha estado robando
decisions.reason: The English Readable speaks to the reader as "you". Spanish would need the singular "tú" for that, which the letter never uses for its readers, so Readable says "any of you" and goes on in the third person. The sense is the same.

source.text: πᾶς λόγος σαπρὸς ἐκ τοῦ στόματος ὑμῶν μὴ ἐκπορευέσθω, ἀλλὰ εἴ τις ἀγαθὸς πρὸς οἰκοδομὴν τῆς χρείας, ἵνα δῷ χάριν τοῖς ἀκούουσιν.

records.literal_gloss: Every word rotten out of the mouth of you not let go out, but if any good for building up of the need, so that it may give grace to those hearing.

en.L: Let no rotten word go out of your mouth, but [only] whatever [is] good for building up [according to] the need, so that it may give grace to those who hear.
en.B: Let no rotten word pass your lips. Say only what is good, what builds up and meets the need of the moment, so that your words bring grace to those who hear them.
en.R: Do not let any ugly or harmful words come out of your mouth. Say only what is good and helpful, what makes others stronger when they need it. Then your words will be a gift of grace to those who hear them.

es.L: Que ninguna palabra podrida salga de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} boca, sino [solo] la que sea buena para edificación [según] la necesidad, para que dé gracia a los que oyen.
es.B: Que ninguna palabra podrida salga de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} labios. {{plural_you:Digan|Decid}} solo lo que es bueno, lo que edifica y responde a la necesidad del momento, para que {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} palabras traigan gracia a quienes las escuchan.
es.R: No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que salgan de {{plural_you:su|vuestra}} boca palabras feas o dañinas. {{plural_you:Digan|Decid}} solo lo que es bueno y útil, lo que fortalece a los demás cuando lo necesitan. Así {{plural_you:sus|vuestras}} palabras serán un regalo de gracia para quienes las oyen.

sw.L: Kila neno lililooza lisitoke katika kinywa chenu, bali [tu] lile lililo jema kwa kujenga [kulingana na] hitaji, ili liwaletee neema wale wanaolisikia.
sw.B: Neno lililooza lisipite midomoni mwenu. Semeni tu yaliyo mema, yanayojenga na kukidhi hitaji la wakati huo, ili maneno yenu yawaletee neema wale wanaoyasikia.
sw.R: Msiache maneno machafu au yenye kudhuru yatoke vinywani mwenu. Semeni tu yaliyo mema na yenye msaada, yale yanayowaimarisha wengine wanapohitaji. Hapo maneno yenu yatakuwa zawadi ya neema kwa wale wanaoyasikia.

decisions.choice: rotten: foul, harmful and worthless
decisions.reason: σαπρὸς is used of rotten fruit and spoiled fish (Matthew 7:17; 13:48). Here it is speech that is foul or that does harm, the opposite of speech that builds up.

decisions.choice: for building up according to the need: what helps, fitted to what the moment calls for
decisions.reason: "Building up of the need" is a compressed phrase: speech that builds others up where there is a need, suited to the situation. "Building up" is the same word as in verses 12 and 16.

decisions.choice: give grace: be a gift and a blessing to the hearers
decisions.reason: χάριν here is a favor or benefit given. Good speech is a means by which God's grace reaches those who hear it.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "of the need"
decisions.reason: A few manuscripts read "of the faith" in place of "of the need". The SBLGNT reading has much wider and earlier support.

decisions.choice: meets the need of the moment; when they need it
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable spell out the compressed phrase (m2).

source.text: καὶ μὴ λυπεῖτε τὸ πνεῦμα τὸ ἅγιον τοῦ θεοῦ, ἐν ᾧ ἐσφραγίσθητε εἰς ἡμέραν ἀπολυτρώσεως.

records.literal_gloss: And not grieve the Spirit the Holy of the God, in whom you were sealed for day of redemption.

en.L: And do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for [the] day of redemption.
en.B: And do not grieve God's Holy Spirit. It was with the Spirit that you were sealed, marked out for the day of redemption.
en.R: Do not make God's Holy Spirit sad. God gave you the Spirit as a seal, a mark that you belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. The Spirit keeps you safe for the day when God will set you completely free.

es.L: Y no {{plural_you:entristezcan|entristezcáis}} al Espíritu Santo de Dios, en quien {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} sellados para [el] día de [la] redención.
es.B: Y no {{plural_you:entristezcan|entristezcáis}} al Espíritu Santo de Dios. Con el Espíritu {{plural_you:fueron|fuisteis}} sellados, marcados para el día de la redención.
es.R: No {{plural_you:pongan|pongáis}} triste al Espíritu Santo de Dios. Dios {{plural_you:les|os}} dio el Espíritu como un sello, una marca de que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} {{plural_you:pertenecen|pertenecéis}}. El Espíritu {{plural_you:los|os}} mantiene a salvo para el día en que Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} liberará por completo.

sw.L: Na msimtie huzuni Roho Mtakatifu wa Mungu, ambaye ndani {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mlipigwa muhuri kwa ajili ya siku ya ukombozi.
sw.B: Na msimhuzunishe Roho Mtakatifu wa Mungu. Ni kwa Roho huyo mlipigwa muhuri, mkawekwa alama kwa ajili ya siku ya ukombozi.
sw.R: Msimfanye Roho Mtakatifu wa Mungu ahuzunike. Mungu aliwapa Roho kama muhuri, alama inayoonyesha kwamba ninyi ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Roho huwalinda salama mpaka siku ya ukombozi, siku ile Mungu atakapowaweka huru kabisa.

decisions.choice: grieve the Holy Spirit: Isaiah 63:10
decisions.reason: Isaiah 63:10 says that Israel in the wilderness rebelled and grieved God's Holy Spirit. The sins of speech and anger in verses 25-31 do the same: they hurt the Spirit who has made the church one (verses 3-4). That the Spirit can be grieved shows that the Spirit is personal.

decisions.choice: sealed: marked as God's own and kept safe
decisions.reason: A seal marked ownership and protected what was sealed. Paul has already said they were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit, the pledge of their inheritance (1:13-14). ἐν ᾧ here means "by" or "with" the Spirit.

decisions.choice: the day of redemption: the day God completes his people's release
decisions.reason: Believers already have redemption through Christ's blood (1:7), but its completion is still to come, on the day when God takes full possession of his people (1:14) and the body is set free (Romans 8:23).

decisions.choice: the day when God will set you completely free
decisions.reason: Readable says "set free" for redemption, as the rest of the letter does, and names God as the one who frees (m3).

decisions.choice: a seal, a mark that you belong to him; keeps you safe
decisions.reason: Readable explains what the seal means (m2), and repeats "the Spirit" rather than using a pronoun.

decisions.choice: siku ya ukombozi, siku ile Mungu atakapowaweka huru kabisa
alternatives: siku ile Mungu atakapowaweka huru kabisa
decisions.reason: "Ukombozi" is the Swahili word for redemption at every level, and it already means setting free. Readable keeps it and adds what the English Readable says in its place, that God will set them completely free (m3).

source.text: πᾶσα πικρία καὶ θυμὸς καὶ ὀργὴ καὶ κραυγὴ καὶ βλασφημία ἀρθήτω ἀφ’ ὑμῶν σὺν πάσῃ κακίᾳ.

records.literal_gloss: All bitterness and rage and anger and shouting and slander let be removed from you with all malice.

en.L: Let all bitterness and rage and anger and shouting and slander be taken away from you, with all malice.
en.B: Get rid of all bitterness, bursts of temper and anger, all shouting and slander, along with every kind of malice.
en.R: Stop being bitter. Do not lose your temper or let anger rule you. Stop shouting at people and saying evil things about them. Get rid of every wish to hurt others.

es.L: Toda amargura, y furia, e ira, y gritería, y calumnia sea quitada de {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}, junto con toda malicia.
es.B: {{plural_you:Desháganse|Deshaceos}} de toda amargura, de los arrebatos de cólera y de la ira, de todo griterío y calumnia, junto con toda clase de malicia.
es.R: {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} de vivir con amargura. No {{plural_you:pierdan|perdáis}} los estribos ni {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que la ira {{plural_you:los|os}} domine. {{plural_you:Dejen|Dejad}} de gritarles a otros y de hablar mal de los demás. {{plural_you:Desháganse|Deshaceos}} de todo deseo de hacer daño a otros.

sw.L: Kila uchungu, na hamaki, na ghadhabu, na makelele, na kashfa yaondolewe kwenu, pamoja na kila ubaya.
sw.B: Achaneni na kila uchungu, milipuko ya hamaki na ghadhabu, kila makelele ya ugomvi na kashfa, pamoja na kila aina ya ubaya.
sw.R: Acheni kuwa na uchungu moyoni. Msipandwe na hamaki, wala msiache ghadhabu iwatawale. Acheni kuwapigia watu kelele na kusema mabaya juu yao. Ondoeni kila nia ya kuwadhuru wengine.

decisions.choice: bitterness, rage, anger, shouting, slander
decisions.reason: πικρία is resentment that has gone sour. θυμὸς is an outburst of temper, ὀργὴ settled anger, κραυγὴ angry shouting, and βλασφημία slander, speech that wounds another's name. Colossians 3:8 has a similar list.

decisions.choice: malice: the wish to harm
decisions.reason: κακίᾳ is ill will, the wish to hurt, the root from which the other sins grow.

decisions.choice: bursts of temper
decisions.reason: As in Colossians 3:8, to tell rage from anger (m1).

decisions.choice: Stop being bitter... Get rid of every wish to hurt others
decisions.reason: Readable turns the list of nouns into plain commands, as Colossians 3:8 does.

decisions.choice: hamaki (θυμὸς); ghadhabu (ὀργὴ)
decisions.reason: "Ghadhabu" is kept for ὀργὴ as in the rest of Paul's letters. θυμὸς, the sudden outburst of temper (m1), is "hamaki", quick hot anger, so the two words stay apart at every level.

source.text: γίνεσθε εἰς ἀλλήλους χρηστοί, εὔσπλαγχνοι, χαριζόμενοι ἑαυτοῖς καθὼς καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἐν Χριστῷ ἐχαρίσατο ὑμῖν.

records.literal_gloss: Become to one another kind, compassionate, forgiving yourselves just as also the God in Christ forgave you.

en.L: Become kind toward one another, compassionate, forgiving each other, just as God also in {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} forgave you.
en.B: Be kind to one another and full of compassion. Forgive each other freely, just as God has forgiven you in {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}.
en.R: Be kind and loving to each other. Forgive each other, just as God forgave you because of what {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} did.

es.L: {{plural_you:Háganse|Haceos}} bondadosos unos con otros, compasivos, {{plural_you:perdonándose|perdonándoos}} unos a otros, así como también Dios en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}} {{plural_you:los|os}} perdonó.
es.B: {{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} bondadosos unos con otros y llenos de compasión. {{plural_you:Perdónense|Perdonaos}} con generosidad, así como Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} ha perdonado en {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Sean|Sed}} amables y cariñosos unos con otros. {{plural_you:Perdónense|Perdonaos}} unos a otros, así como Dios {{plural_you:los|os}} perdonó por lo que hizo {{christos:Cristo|el Mesías}}.

sw.L: Kuweni wema kwa mtu na mwenzake, wenye moyo wa huruma, mkisameheana, kama vile pia Mungu aliwasamehe ninyi katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.B: Kuweni wema kwa kila mmoja wenu na wenye huruma nyingi. Sameheaneni kwa moyo mkunjufu, kama vile Mungu alivyowasamehe ninyi katika {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}.
sw.R: Kuweni wapole na wenye upendo ninyi kwa ninyi. Sameheaneni, kama Mungu alivyowasamehe kwa sababu ya kile {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} alichofanya.

decisions.choice: compassionate: warm-hearted, quick to feel for others
decisions.reason: εὔσπλαγχνοι means having good inner parts; in the Bible the inner parts are where compassion is felt (Colossians 3:12).

decisions.choice: forgiving: giving freely, as God forgave
decisions.reason: χαριζόμενοι comes from the same root as χάρις: to forgive is to give freely what is not earned. The model is God's forgiveness (Colossians 3:13).

decisions.choice: in Christ: through what God did in Christ
decisions.reason: God forgave them in Christ: through Christ's death (1:7) and because they are joined to him.

decisions.choice: follow SBLGNT: "forgave you"
decisions.reason: Many manuscripts read "forgave us". Both readings are early; the SBLGNT reads "you", which matches the commands addressed to "you". The meaning is not changed.

decisions.choice: {{christos:Christ|Messiah}}
decisions.reason: Title setting.

decisions.choice: because of what {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} did
decisions.reason: Readable explains "in Christ" (m3).
